source.author: verg
source.text: Parce metu, Cytherea: manent immota tuorum fata tibi; cernes urbem et promissa Lavini moenia, sublimemque feres ad sidera caeli magnanimum Aenean; neque me sententia vertit.
source.text_original: 'Parce metu, Cytherea: manent immota tuorum / fata tibi; cernes urbem et promissa Lavini / moenia, sublimemque feres ad sidera caeli / magnanimum Aenean; neque me sententia vertit.
source.text_english: Spare your fear, Cytherea: the fates of your people remain unshaken for you; you will see the city and the promised walls of Lavinium, and you will carry up to the stars of heaven great-souled Aeneas; nor does my resolve change.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_original: 'mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, / iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum / prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_english: Dismiss your fears; he is flying over the sea, and the nearer he draws, the more and more Aea is amazed at the various portents of the gods, and the fierce oracles shake the Colchians.
